overclaims.abstract: There is high evidence that chronic exercise benefits overall depression severity in older adults.
overclaims.body: only one of the twelve included reviews was considered to be of high methodological quality
overclaims.why: The body reports that only one of twelve prior reviews was of high methodological quality and that heterogeneity is high, which does not support a claim of high evidence.

unsettled: The results of the proposed review are anticipated to have a substantial impact on research and clinical practice.
